remarks: Discover the exquisite charm of 13 Glendenning Street in Norwalk, CT. This stunning 1930 residence presents 4 bedrooms within its expansive 2299 square feet, situated on a generous 7405 square foot lot.The covered front porch, replete with porch swing, welcomes you to this gem. Step inside to find a seamless open floor plan, creating an inviting space for both relaxation and entertaining. The kitchen is a sleek and stylish focal point, featuring beautiful finishes and ample storage.  The primary bedroom boasts a 2 story tranquil escape with ample natural light and closet space. The additional bedrooms are versatile, accommodating various needs and preferences.  Outside, the spacious lot provides endless potential for outdoor enjoyment and customization to suit your lifestyle.  Located in Norwalk, residents will appreciate easy access to a variety of local amenities, entertainment, and dining options, ensuring a vibrant and dynamic living experience.
